overall_comment: Strong pair on D1.2 frequency tables. Trap (numerical values mis-classified as qualitative) is research-grounded with Lehrer & Schauble (2002) and NCTM data trajectories cited by name; recovery_moves branch by diagnostic A/B/C. Tally's refrain 'WORDS go in QUAL, NUMBERS go in QUANT!' chants 3x at exit and is quotable. Puppets explicitly OPTIONAL with substitutes. NO-PAPER PATH (two-line body-becomes-frequency-table) is included in differentiation. INVENT-AND-COMPARE step (pairs design two frequency-table layouts, class compares which makes totals easier) lets children invent and compare strategies — clears Level 4 mathematical_authenticity. Worksheet's three parts each practise a named success criterion and the survey-invention task is a transfer-format variation, not rote repeat. Time 12/25/13 = 50 min realistic for Grade 3.
